config.description: YAML file with model, data and path settings; it selects the experiment

stage.description: run one preparation stage only (clock, joints, features, stats); all runs them in sequence

corpus.description: build the unlabeled AMASS pretraining corpus and not the captioned data set

adopt_pose_folder.title: Adopt Pose Folder

regen_dir.description: folder with the regenerated poses and joints that the corpus is built from
regen_dir.title: Regen Dir

corpus_dir.description: output folder of the AMASS 263-feature corpus
corpus_dir.title: Corpus Dir

min_frames.description: clips shorter than this are dropped; a higher value gives fewer, longer clips
min_frames.title: Min Frames

limit.description: convert only the first N sequences, for a quick test; 0 converts all
limit.title: Limit

source_release.description: folder of an official HumanML3D release to convert; skips all other stages

converted_dir.description: output folder for the converted official release

config.description: YAML file with model, data and path settings; it selects the experiment

tokenizer_ckpt.description: frozen tokenizer checkpoint; default from the config
tokenizer_ckpt.title: Tokenizer Ckpt

token_pack.description: output .npz file of tokens; pretraining reads this file
token_pack.title: Token Pack

segment_frames.description: window length in frames; clips shorter than one window are not encoded
segment_frames.title: Segment Frames

stride.description: step between windows; a smaller stride gives more, overlapping windows
stride.title: Stride

regen_dir.description: folder with pose_data; the heldout clips are found and excluded through it
regen_dir.title: Regen Dir

config.description: YAML file with model, data and path settings; it selects the experiment

exploratory.description: record a non-protocol run that is not citable; protocol runs use seed 2026
exploratory.title: Exploratory

tokenizer.description: quantizer family: fsq has no learned codebook, rvq is the baseline

window.description: training crop in frames; a longer crop gives more context and uses more memory
window.title: Window

batch_size.description: clips per step; limited by GPU memory
batch_size.title: Batch Size

ema_decay.description: decay of the averaged weights that are evaluated; higher is smoother and slower
ema_decay.title: Ema Decay

max_eval_clips.description: cap on evaluation clips; a low cap is faster and gives a noisier FID
max_eval_clips.title: Max Eval Clips

max_steps.description: stop after this many optimizer steps, for equal-step comparisons; not with --resume
max_steps.title: Max Steps

num_workers.description: data loader processes; 0 loads in the training process and needs the least RAM
num_workers.title: Num Workers

amass_share.description: share of AMASS clips in each epoch; 0 trains on HumanML3D only
amass_share.title: Amass Share

amass_features.description: folder with the AMASS 263 features; required when amass_share is above 0
amass_features.title: Amass Features

ckpt_name.description: checkpoint file name inside the checkpoint folder; also names the run
ckpt_name.title: Ckpt Name

resume.description: continue from the saved state of this checkpoint

compile.title: Compile

epochs.description: target epoch; the cosine schedule spans exactly this many epochs
epochs.title: Epochs

batch_size.description: clips per step; keep it equal for both backbones
batch_size.title: Batch Size

num_workers.description: data loader processes; more is faster, and each one needs RAM; 0 needs the least
num_workers.title: Num Workers

grad_accum.description: batches per optimizer step; effective batch is batch_size times this
grad_accum.title: Grad Accum

cfg_scale.description: guidance scale for the validation samples; higher follows the text more closely
cfg_scale.title: Cfg Scale

eval_every.description: epochs between validation runs; each run can select a new best checkpoint
eval_every.title: Eval Every

max_eval_clips.description: validation clips; fewer is faster and gives a noisier FID
max_eval_clips.title: Max Eval Clips

eval_batch_size.description: clips generated together in validation; changes speed, not the result
eval_batch_size.title: Eval Batch Size

temperature.description: sampling temperature for validation; higher gives more varied motion
temperature.title: Temperature

vocab_dir.description: word-vector folder of the evaluator; default from the config
vocab_dir.title: Vocab Dir

ckpt_name.description: file name of the best checkpoint inside the checkpoint folder
ckpt_name.title: Ckpt Name

resume.description: continue from the saved last state of ckpt_name
resume.title: Resume

fresh_selection.description: with --resume: reset earlier best FID and validation-CE patience for this run
fresh_selection.title: Fresh Selection

resume_run_dir.description: existing run folder to continue the log in; keeps one folder for one training
resume_run_dir.title: Resume Run Dir

patience.description: stop after this many validations without a better FID; 0 never stops early
patience.title: Patience

clean_ce.description: after each epoch, log the teacher-forced CE on a fixed train subset and on validation
clean_ce.title: Clean Ce

ce_batches.description: batches of --eval_batch_size clips for each clean CE; 0 uses the full split
ce_batches.title: Ce Batches

val_ce_patience.description: stop on this consecutive epoch without a lower clean validation CE; default 6 allows five retries; 0 disables

stop_epoch.description: stop after this epoch while --epochs still sets the cosine length; 0 runs to --epochs
stop_epoch.title: Stop Epoch

select_on_val_ce.description: save the best bundle at the lowest clean validation CE, not at the lowest val FID
select_on_val_ce.title: Select On Val Ce

save_r1_floor.description: save the best-FID bundle only at an evaluation whose val R@1 is at least this value; an evaluation below it counts as no improvement; default 0 keeps every run unchanged
save_r1_floor.title: Save R1 Floor

accept_legacy_resume.description: with --resume: load an old resume file; its RNG and schedule state start fresh
accept_legacy_resume.title: Accept Legacy Resume

extend_schedule.description: with --resume: accept a new --epochs; the learning rate follows the new cosine
extend_schedule.title: Extend Schedule
